intent: Shipped documents are prose: a wording edit needs no charter
notes: A wording change to one of Gator's shipped HTML documents still needed a Dashboard Server charter edit or an Architect approval (#110). The commit hook counts `.html` as code, and `INDEX.md` routed every shipped document to Dashboard Server as its only charter.

The commit hook now treats `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/docs/` as prose, like Markdown, in both hook copies. HTML anywhere else is still code, because in many governed repositories it is application code. `INDEX.md` no longer routes the documents; adding, renaming or removing one still changes `WELCOME_DOC_NAMES`, which is code under Dashboard Server.
Architect decision: option (c) from #110, both parts.
